title.en: Winter Day with Snow in Baldersbrønde
title.zh: 巴尔德斯布伦德的雪日

institution.name: SMK – Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1933. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1933 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: A village road curves through snow past low yellow farmhouses with snowy roofs. A large pollarded willow with bare, feathery branches stands at the roadside, and the sky is a pale winter grey.
alt.zh: 一条村路在雪中弯过几座低矮的黄色农舍，屋顶积着雪。路边立着一棵截过顶的大柳树，枝条光秃而纤细，天空是冬日的浅灰。

note.en: Ring was a Danish painter of ordinary rural life, roads, fields and villagers, painted without sentiment and with great care; he lived in Baldersbrønde on Zealand for some years and painted it often. The pollarded willow is a working tree, cut back again and again so that it grows anew, a fair emblem for a library that keeps renewing old things.
note.zh: 林是丹麦画家，画平常的乡村生活——道路、田野、村民——不煽情，却极其用心；他曾在西兰岛的巴尔德斯布伦德住过一些年，常常画这里。那棵截顶的柳树是“干活的树”，一次次被剪短、一次次重新长出；用来象征一座不断让旧物焕新的图书馆，正合适。
